title: Edition 02
description:
Its a semi formal meetup for designers.

The agenda includes:
1. A Story: By an experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of a career in Design.

2. Tutorial / Skill Building Session: By an experienced Designer to teach us something new.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This will be a group activity, the participants will be split into groups of 4-5 people.

We will have markers, sketch pens and chart papers for your use.

This event is strictly for designers.

Cheers,
